title: Stop the Unix cleanup worker from spinning after spawn preparation unwinds
outcome: Stop the Unix cleanup worker from spinning after spawn preparation unwinds
acceptance: If child preparation unwinds after the cleanup thread starts but before prepared is published, the worker terminates or keeps a bounded nonzero wait after the original deadline; it never spins a CPU core indefinitely.

An isolated behavioral regression triggers preparation failure with a runtime missing required drivers and verifies bounded worker/result disposition without losing any already-created child ownership.
